notes.title: Espresso Tycoon – full version - NOW ON STEAM!
notes.content:
Dear Coffee Lovers, 

The day has come!

The full version of Espresso Tycoon is now available for all of you to play on Steam!

We listened carefully to the voice of our community. We took into account the suggestions made in the demo and playtests and improved the game based on that. We also asked for opinions on several key issues, such as the choice of locations for the Prologue or the addition of new languages. We are very grateful for such a strongly involved community!

We wouldn't be here without you!

We hope the game will meet your expectations! We look forward to your feedback. 😄
[previewyoutube=IZjz7fwTL2c;full][/previewyoutube]

Earlier we announced that on the day of release, we will give you cheat codes for unlocking all the locations in the Sandbox. However, we decided that we will unlock them by default 😄 Enjoy!

Your Coffee Enthusiasts,
DreamWay Games Team

notes.title: Espresso Tycoon Prologue: Underwater - PATCH #4
notes.content:
Dear Coffee Lovers,

As you know, we are getting ready to release the full version of Espresso Tycoon (which is coming to Steam on the 7th of June!). But before that, we wanted to give you a new opportunity in the Prologue. 😄

We are adding a new feature - Resolution Quality.

In the game settings, you can use the slider to efficiently change the resolution of the game.

Here's how to use it:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/5878460ff026dc7607a3218d2d4e070abc430dc5.gif

Here you can compare the difference:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/cdee5245dfbc004dbfda3a4876e2f8f013282d2e.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/e500f1f0a25e68603cebbec19a2e808db2f07a94.png

This is a feature that will be especially useful for those who play on low-end hardware.

You will notice that it affects the quality of the graphics, but you will be able to freely adjust it to match the capabilities of your computer using the slider.

We hope that this will make the game run smoothly for you. 😄

Let us know your thoughts!

And remember - the full version of Espresso Tycoon is coming to Steam on the 7th of June! Don't forget to add to your Wishlist ːsteamhappyː

Your Coffee Enthusiasts,
DreamWay Games Team

notes.title: Espresso Tycoon - the full version - RELEASE DATE - 7th of June!
notes.content:
Dear Coffee Lovers,

The day we've been waiting for (and we know you've been waiting too 😊) has arrived! We are incredibly proud to announce that...

Espresso Tycoon (the full version of the game) is coming to Steam on the 7th of June!

[previewyoutube=tj3sp0O7Ww0;full][/previewyoutube]

We have prepared 10 different locations for you and approximately 1,000 decorative elements. You'll find lots of ingredients and toppings to create delicious coffees, as well as a unique tool to draw your own Latte Art... and many, many more features!

We put a lot of heart, energy, and work into this project. We are tremendously excited that we will soon be able to share it with the whole world!

Of course, we wouldn't be here without you – our players. 
Thank you for your support, trust, and understanding. We are glad that you liked our demo so much, and also our Prologue (by the way, it was you who chose the location for the Prologue 😊). 

We hope you will love the full version of Espresso Tycoon as much as we do!

So... are we all set for the 7th of June? 😉

notes.title: Check out ALL the locations!
notes.content:
Dear Coffee Lovers,

As you already know, we're preparing 10 different locations (and missions) for you in Espresso Tycoon. You already know two of them - Sydney, the underwater one, and London, where our Tutorial is located. 

It's time to present what we're preparing for you!

1. Cape Town
You can already know that location from our short demo of the full version of Espresso Tycoon. You start your journey here. This is a great place to run a coffee truck and an outdoor cafe!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/9e57f642e76916b884179efa32ddf8fdb9f67cba.png

2. New York
Run your coffee shop in a city that never sleeps and has a lot of coffee shops where you can spend time with your... Friends 😉
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/af9aa32f2f01d07e351ec068b046a6ef28521641.png

3. São Paulo
Take care of the customers who are always in a rush - because you're running a coffee shop in a subway station 🚇
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/3f64012dfeb2f9b8ca0fc52498cec15f0b30c744.jpg

4. Paris
Enjoy the beautiful surroundings and exquisite flavors. Conquer the capital of fashion - with your coffee shop in Paris 🥐
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/78676f875eea26d6b3b2cc930d29e77eeb24d315.png

5. Siberia
Take a long train trip. A very long one! Don't forget to serve your customers a good cup of coffee - it will be useful for them not to get cold 🚆
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/d5f2b464278b5b5dc75404a7b378c0fe57b297b4.png

6. London
You can already know that location from our first demo and the tutorial added to our Prologue. Improve your management skills and be careful - some say you may get robbed there!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/206dabc8b8368624e8c1515383509febd02c2392.png

7. Mexico City
Who wouldn't want to relax in a five-star hotel with a good cup of coffee? Take care of your customers who want to enjoy a relaxing stay here. They also want to enjoy some pieces of art! Do you think you'll be able to bring the 'Mona Lisa' here?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/c34fde6ebaede884f22089388985a4e8e05df6ed.png

8. Sydney
That location is pretty popular. You've chosen the underwater coffee shop as our Prologue's location. Run a successful coffee business and take care of the sea creatures (and customers, too, of course)!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/311894edb8ac63608fc2ea783eb4029741ebfa15.jpg

9. Los Angeles
To get to Hollywood - this is the dream of many. And you will be able to run your cafe there! Beach, palm trees, ocean, and good coffee - it's a match!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/1d7512b429685754a04f589353767d90cb2a186c.png

10. Tokyo
Last but not least! Tokyo is still the world's largest city in terms of population, so you can expect to need a lot of coffee there... Will you manage to take care of so many customers?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/6b357b290449dde956af8dbd3c341e8e57ef609c.png

Which one do you like the most? ːsteamhappyː

P.S. How did you name your underwater coffee shop in our Prologue? ːsteamhappyː
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1904980/Espresso_Tycoon_Prologue_Underwater/

But... let's start from the beginning. Coffee is our hero in Espresso Tycoon, you know that. But we don't forget about our four-legged loved ones!
That's why... we're adding some animals to our game!

In the full version of the game we will have cats:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/83f8873ccecb3d0b3f152a833b953c22b25e57a6.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/32358e596703ec37809266d77e2ecc88a29d8b49.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/65ce2110f3e63c509ad7dd71d72dd5d0bc541397.png

And some more animals, like flamingos, pigeons, ducks, or swans!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/5d57a8753e54ca11cecef0a5ae576e19f32c4a4f.png

There will be also some sea creatures which you can already know from our Prologue.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/0e7297af079bbdc3649163984f258d063e576a48.gif

And here's the BIG NEWS!

We can add your pet to Espresso Tycoon!

Send the picture of your pet to media@dreamwaygames.com.

Our jury will decide which 3 of them will appear in our game. 

Just like the dog Halinka here:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986779/4cfbae615b80d6ee5f43d08da0d87a2554191987.png

We will also add one special screenshot on our Steam page with all the winning pictures presented in the game.
We will make a special announcement with ALL the pets you sent to us!

Here are some rules:
1. You're sending a picture (max 3 different pictures) to us via: media@dreamwaygames.com.
2. By sending the picture you're admitting that you are the owner of that image and you have all the copyrights needed (in a nutshell - you admit that you're the author of that picture).
3. By sending the picture to us you allow us to use these images in the game for free and agree to publish them on steam and on our social media. 
4. It may be obvious, but we have to say this - you can't send us drastic or obscene photos.
5, By taking part in the contest you're agreeing with its Rules.

You can send us these pictures by January 31st!

Do you remember our voting for languages that you want to be added to the full version of Espresso Tycoon?

And remember - we're going to release Espresso Tycoon in Spring 2023! 

It's going to be so much fun!

notes.title: How can WE save the ocean?
notes.content:
Dear Coffee Lovers,

In Espresso Tycoon Prologue: Underwater we want to add some features that will help raise awareness about the need of protecting the ocean.

It is well known that there is a lot of garbage floating in the ocean, which threatens many animal species. And it is the actions of each of us that can improve this condition.

We want to show this in the game. We have our ideas - but we want to listen to yours.
How can we raise awareness about this issue in a game about running an underwater cafe?

Share your thoughts!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/1889f84864c07c5325b61ccbb378344fad5e4cca.png
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1904980/Espresso_Tycoon_Prologue_Underwater/

notes.title: Espresso Tycoon Prologue: Underwater is coming THIS OCTOBER!
notes.content:
Dear Coffee Lovers,

We are more than happy to announce that our Espresso Tycoon Prologue: Underwater is coming THIS OCTOBER!

Here's the gameplay trailer:
[previewyoutube=bDRP51oRWaM;full][/previewyoutube]
WHY UNDERWATER (SYDNEY)?

YOU chose the location! In our voting that one got the most votesːsteamhappyː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967492/64c3208d12942d847a984b8e519ee85bcd4b647d.jpg

And we’re listening to your voice!

The Prologue’s development has been shaped by the analysis of your feedback. During playtests and Steam Next Fest, our players filled out almost 1000 surveys. Armed with this feedback, we’ve fixed a lot of bugs, improved the camera movement, and the game balance, and - of course - added a bunch of new features:


 a possibility to have more than one barista working at the same time
 skipping time to the next day
 new decoration items
 a possibility of selling snacks 
 toppings in the coffee editor
 profit and loss table
 different coffee machines
 a possibility to save and load the game state
 a brand new main menu screen

SEA CREATURES

Of course, such a location requires unique and specific surroundings. Your customers will admire sharks, jellyfish, octopus, and sunken ships…The supplies will be delivered by submarines! (Drones wouldn’t fly here, right?)
